B2.text: Skyway Charters satisfies regional aviation compliance benchmarks.

B3.text: Crestline Express demonstrates extensive ground transit coverage.

B4.text: Crestline Express achieves major overland operator classification.

B5.text: Skyway Charters retains primary flight authorization.

B6.text: Skyway Charters satisfies international access requirements.

B8.text: Skyway Charters holds robust operational infrastructure.

B10.text: Delta Freight Services satisfies heavy transport fleet requirements.

B11.text: Delta Freight Services attains priority logistics authorization.

D4.text: Delta Freight Services is awarded the state distribution contract.

B12.text: Eagle Transit achieves top-tier financial qualification.

B13.text: Falcon Charter maintains certified service standards.

B14.text: Grand Tour Agency secures comprehensive liability protection.

B15.text: Highline Rail Corp controls substantial rail transport infrastructure.

policies.B1: A carrier achieves adequate fleet capacity when operating a minimum of 10 vans.
policies.B2: An airline meets regional operational standards with an active aircraft count of at least 10 regional aircraft, a Class A air carrier certificate, and a safety score of no less than 90 points.
policies.B3: Broad transit reach is established when an operator maintains a minimum of 30 coaches.
policies.B4: Major overland standing is awarded to any entity with broad transit reach.
policies.D1: National transport allocation is granted to entities maintaining major overland standing.
policies.B5: Flight clearance is granted to an operator holding a Class A air carrier certificate with a regional safety score reaching 90 points, or maintaining an emergency fleet count of at least 6 aircraft.
policies.B6: Global hub access requires an operator to possess at least 4 international landing slots or hold an international operating permit.
policies.B7: International schedule approval is conferred when an enterprise with global hub access maintains an arrival delay under 15 minutes.
policies.D2: Preferred partner status is assigned to any carrier holding international schedule approval.
policies.B8: Infrastructure readiness requires employing at least 20 maintenance technicians, possessing 4 international landing slots, or operating 6 emergency aircraft.
policies.B9: Dependable status approval is conferred on an enterprise with demonstrated infrastructure readiness that records no more than 1 major incident over 5 years.
policies.D3: Government transit vendor selection requires obtaining dependable status approval.
policies.B10: Heavy haulage capacity requires operating at least 20 trucks.
policies.B11: Priority movement clearance requires meeting heavy haulage capacity while holding a freight permit.
policies.D4: State logistics contracts are assigned to enterprises obtaining priority movement clearance.
policies.B12: Top-tier fiscal status requires yearly turnover of at least $10,000,000.
policies.B13: Service quality approval requires holding an ISO 9001 certification.
policies.B14: Liability clearance is granted to an agency carrying insurance coverage of at least $2,000,000.
policies.B15: Rail fleet qualification requires operating at least 15 locomotives.

decoy_policies: Cold storage certification is awarded to a warehouse facility maintaining at least 5 climate zones.
Harbor towing endorsement requires a maritime tug vessel with an engine output of at least 3000 horsepower.

B3: Crestline Express operating 40 coaches meets the threshold of 30 coaches for broad transit reach.

B5: Skyway Charters holding a Class A certificate and scoring 94 points satisfies the first alternative for flight clearance.
Skyway Charters maintaining an emergency fleet of 8 aircraft satisfies the second alternative requiring at least 6 aircraft.

D2: Skyway Charters possessing international schedule approval satisfies the policy requirement for preferred partner status.
B8: Skyway Charters employing 25 maintenance technicians satisfies the first infrastructure readiness alternative requiring at least 20 technicians.
Skyway Charters holding 5 international landing slots satisfies the second infrastructure readiness alternative requiring at least 4 slots.
Skyway Charters operating 8 emergency aircraft satisfies the third infrastructure readiness alternative requiring at least 6 aircraft.
B9: Skyway Charters having infrastructure readiness and recording 0 major incidents over 5 years satisfies the reliability endorsement requirement of no more than 1 incident.
D3: Skyway Charters securing a reliability endorsement satisfies the policy requirement for government transit vendor selection.
B10: Delta Freight Services operating 30 trucks meets the heavy haulage threshold of 20 trucks.
B11: Delta Freight Services meeting heavy haulage capacity and holding a freight permit satisfies the priority movement clearance policy.
D4: Delta Freight Services obtaining priority movement clearance meets the policy criteria for state logistics contract assignment.
B12: Eagle Transit reporting annual revenue of 15 million dollars satisfies the top-tier fiscal requirement of at least 10 million dollars.
B13: Falcon Charter holding an ISO 9001 certification meets the requirement for service quality approval.
B14: Grand Tour Agency carrying insurance coverage of 5 million dollars satisfies the liability clearance requirement of at least 2 million dollars.
B15: Highline Rail Corp operating 25 locomotives meets the rail fleet qualification threshold of 15 locomotives.
